about_the_game:
Skullhunter: a Worm's Soundtrack offers 1 hour and 29 minutes of intense music to rock out to all day, and play while you're playing other games. The boss battle themes are also all written by the creator of Skullhunter: a Worm's Tale, Oliver Arett, and they each include strait BARS based on the bosses' unique twists.

The soundtrack includes all of the bosses' sung themes(sung by the bosses themselves!), and also the alternate instrumental versions of the boss themes.

Also, the instrumental themes of each of the worlds, and the intro and victory music is included.

(one of the bosses singing his UNIQUE SONG!!!!!)
